scenarios: No preselected files. Selections from different pages and categories survive filtering; the exact two paths and combined size appear before any apply.
Changing a reviewed selection returns to the list. A stale receipt clears all selection and requires fresh review.
Close review only shows temporary and reproducible categories. Continue without cleanup and Escape never apply and return distinct outcomes.
During a commit the dialog suppresses dismissal and exposes its committing state to native close. A matching receipt enables Continue only after completion.
Partial removal is disclosed and cannot acknowledge successful cleanup. The user can re-inspect disk contents.

Title-bar Close keeps an unrelated existing storage review open.

Deleting one named snapshot removes exactly its manifest. Exclusive caches can be selected in a subsequent review, while the remaining project still protects shared outputs.
Overwriting a recognised old export with different bytes of equal length invalidates its receipt and refuses the stale deletion.
Choosing just a generated report and a demo file deletes exactly those assets, leaving the user-replaced export and all still-unselected working caches intact.

Confirmed multi-project removal quarantines the old-only union once and preserves shared/live/undo/recovery files and protected or unknown inputs byte-for-byte.
Reviewed unreferenced-data cleanup removes exactly the generated orphan. The active project, portable copy, executable, original input, unrelated folder/file, hard link and symlink survive.
storage_ownership_ui.platform: Temporary synthetic project assets, real application HTTP routes and Linux Chromium. No production data.
